IS 6932 : Part 6 : 2025 Building Limes - Method of Test - Part 6 Determination of Volume Yield of Quicklime
ICS 91.100.10
ICS 91.100.10
CED 04

1 SCOPE
This standard (Part 6) covers the methods of tests for determination of volume yield of quicklime.
2 REFERENCES
The standards given below contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid.
